body_text:
If $f'=0$ throughout an interval, then $f$ is constant there. If
$f'\geq0$ throughout an interval, then $f$ is nondecreasing. Both
conclusions follow by applying the mean value theorem to an
arbitrary pair of points; the interval hypothesis ensures that the
entire segment between them lies in the domain.
